ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.comment: Landale (hip) is out for Sunday's game against Bucks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Kingston Flemings
ATL.comment: Flemings (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bucks.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.comment: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BOS.name: Neemias Queta
BOS.comment: Queta (rest) won't play in Monday's game against the Magic, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

CHI.name: Jalen Smith
CHI.comment: Smith (undisclosed) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 126-115 loss to the Cavaliers and did not return.

CHI.name: Patrick Williams
CHI.comment: Williams (finger) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against Cleveland.

CHI.name: Tobe Awaka
CHI.comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

CLE.name: Jaylon Tyson
CLE.comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Chicago.

CLE.name: Peyton Watson
CLE.comment: Watson left Monday's 126-115 win over Chicago due to a head injury and did not return.

CLE.name: Evan Mobley
CLE.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

CLE.name: Sam Merrill
CLE.comment: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bulls.

CLE.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
CLE.comment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

DAL.name: Max Christie
DAL.comment: Christie (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

DAL.name: Santi Aldama
DAL.comment: Aldama (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

DAL.name: Kyrie Irving
DAL.comment: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.comment: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Taurean Prince
DET.comment: Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

DET.name: Ronald Holland II
DET.comment: Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.comment: Joe (hip) is doubtful to play in Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

DET.name: Duncan Robinson
DET.comment: Robinson (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.comment: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Amen Thompson
HOU.comment: Thompson (knee) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

HOU.name: Marcus Smart
HOU.comment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.comment: Adams (calf) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

HOU.name: Clint Capela
HOU.comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

HOU.name: Julian Phillips
HOU.comment: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

IND.name: Andrew Nembhard
IND.comment: Nembhard (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.comment: Niederhauser (foot) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Jazz.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAL.name: Austin Reaves
LAL.comment: Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

LAL.name: Walker Kessler
LAL.comment: Walker (leg) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets.

MEM.name: Isaiah Stewart
MEM.comment: Stewart is out for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.

MEM.name: Ty Jerome
MEM.comment: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.comment: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

MEM.name: GG Jackson
MEM.comment: Jackson will undergo surgery to repair the broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot and is set to miss significant time.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MIA.name: Nikola Jovic
MIA.comment: Jovic (illness) is out for Monday's game against Houston.

MIA.name: Bam Adebayo
MIA.comment: Coach Erik Spoelstra stated after Monday's 128-110 win over Houston that the team held Adebayo (hip) out of the second half in an effort to be proactive, and the injury isn't expected to be a long-term issue, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.

MIA.name: Pelle Larsson
MIA.comment: Larsson won't play in Monday's game against the Rockets due to an illness, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

MIL.name: Ryan Rollins
MIL.comment: Rollins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against the Hawks.

MIL.name: Ousmane Dieng
MIL.comment: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

MIN.name: Jonathan Kuminga
MIN.comment: Kuminga (shoulder) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 106-98 win over Portland and did not return. He closed with 13 points (5-12 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), nine rebounds and one assist across 29 minutes.

MIN.name: Jaylen Clark
MIN.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.comment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

NO.name: Bryce McGowens
NO.comment: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

NO.name: Trey Murphy III
NO.comment: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

NO.name: Trendon Watford
NO.comment: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

NO.name: Dejounte Murray
NO.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

OKC.name: Jaylin Williams
OKC.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Kings.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

PHI.name: Jaylen Brown
PHI.comment: Brown (hamstring/head) will undergo further evaluation Tuesday and could receive an MRI, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.

PHI.name: LeBron James
PHI.comment: James (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.

PHI.name: Dominick Barlow
PHI.comment: Barlow (back) will be re-evaluated later in the week and is thought to be nearing his 2026-27 season debut, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

PHI.name: Adem Bona
PHI.comment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.comment: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

SAC.name: Zach LaVine
SAC.comment: LaVine is out for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City due to illness, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

SAC.name: De'Andre Hunter
SAC.comment: Hunter (hip) is out for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

SAC.name: Precious Achiuwa
SAC.comment: Achiuwa (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Thunder, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.comment: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
TOR.comment: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.comment: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

UTAH.name: Jaxson Hayes
UTAH.comment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

UTAH.name: Jusuf Nurkic
UTAH.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

WSH.name: Reece Beekman
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
